thread:
maria: FYI customer 'acme-qa' opened an escalation — high 5xx and Gateway 504s during a load burst (hosted inference). Happening since 14:12 UTC, spike lasted ~90s :rotating_light:
ashok: can you paste a short sample of the errors and any stack/traces?
maria: support ticket INC-4821 -> https://support.redwood.example/t/INC-4821. Sample from gateway logs: 
```
2025-09-02T14:12:07Z gateway tenant=acme-qa req=abc123 status=504 backend=timeout msg="upstream request timed out after 10s"
2025-09-02T14:12:08Z gateway tenant=acme-qa req=def456 status=502 backend=connect_timeout
```
jess: initial telemetry shows KEDA/HPA scale events but pods stayed NotReady for ~30-50s due to model init. Queue length spiked while waiting for pods. Looks like warmup + readiness probe failures.
ashok: can you share k8s events & prometheus queries you used?
jess: k8s events excerpt:
```
Events:
  Normal   ScalingReplicaSet   scaled up replica set inference-56d4 to 8
  Normal   Pulling             Pulling image redwood-inference:v2.3.1
  Normal   Created             Created container inference
  Warning  Unhealthy           Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed after 1s
  Warning  Failed              PostStart hook timeout
```
Prom queries used: 
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (tenant)
sum(kube_pod_container_status_ready{namespace="inference",pod=~"inference-.*"}) by (pod)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(pod_startup_time_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
sre-bot: autoscaler events: scaledobject=acme-qa-so trigger=azure-queue(queueLength) old=2 new=8 pollingInterval=30s cooldown=300s
sam: oncall here — I'm taking this. Immediate plan: route acme-qa to fallback lighter model variant and apply a short-term scaledobject tweak to reduce coldstart impact. @jess can you confirm fallback is warm?
jess: fallback variant is warm for that tenant; I routed 100% traffic to fallback in routing layer. Also setting scaledobject.minReplicaCount=4 for now and lowering pollingInterval to 10s. Applying readinessProbe.timeoutSeconds=5 to reduce flapping.
maria: told customer we've routed to fallback and applied mitigations, they're monitoring.
ashok: hypothesis: KEDA pollingInterval=30s + minReplicaCount=2 + long model init (~20-40s) -> queue accumulates -> gateway times out at 10s. Readiness probe too aggressive, postStart hook may be blocking.
sam: immediate commands I'm running: 
```
kubectl patch scaledobject acme-qa-so -n inference --type merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicaCount":4,"pollingInterval":10}}'
kubectl set env deploy/inference -n inference READINESS_TIMEOUT=5
# route change handled in routing service
```
sre-bot: alert: scaledobject patched, new minReplicaCount=4; KEDA poll=10s.
support-bot: INC-4821 updated: mitigations applied, customer notified :thumbsup:
maria: can we capture repro steps for postmortem? Customer test steps: run 200 RPS spike for 60s, model=large-llama, concurrency=1 per request, tenant header X-Tenant: acme-qa. They provided a synthetic curl: 
```
for i in `seq 1 200`; do curl -s -H "X-Tenant: acme-qa" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"..."}' & done
```
ashok: long-term fix ideas: prewarm jobs for heavy models, increase default minReplicaCount for tenants over threshold, add async warmup endpoint and better warmup telemetry, and make KEDA pollingInterval configurable per tenant. Also change readiness probe to check process + model-ready endpoint instead of a 1s HTTP probe.
jess: I'll open a PR with: prewarm job template, model-ready endpoint check, and telemetry for model init durations. Also adding runbook steps for oncall.
sam: leaving note in handover: follow up with eng-runtime on PR, confirm rollback plan. I'll keep monitoring for 10m.
maria: thanks all — marking Slack loop closed; will track postmortem + customer follow-up. :white_check_mark:
